बवाल मच गया है भाई, रजनीकांत की फिल्म ने यूके में इतिहास रच दिया है! 💥

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, Rajinikanth की फिल्म Jailer 2 ने UK बॉक्स ऑफिस पर तहलका मचा दिया है। 🎬
फिल्म ने पहले दिन £394K की कमाई की थी और 10 दिनों में कुल £1.6 million (भारतीय रुपयों में 15.19 crore) का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया है। 💸
इस जबरदस्त कमाई के साथ यह Kollywood की आज तक की सबसे बड़ी यानी highest-grossing फिल्म बन गई है। 🏆
इसने Leo (£1.58 million) को पीछे छोड़ते हुए नंबर वन की कुर्सी अपने नाम कर ली है। 📈
बता दें कि इसे Nelson Dilipkumar ने डायरेक्ट और Kalanithi Maran के Sun Pictures ने प्रोड्यूस किया है, जो 15 October 2026 को रिलीज़ हुई थी। 🎥

क्या आपने अभी तक यह ब्लॉकबस्टर फिल्म देखी है या नहीं? 🍿

ctx.title: Jailer 2 UK Box Office: Makes History As Kollywood’s Highest-Grossing Film Of All Time!
ctx.summary:
Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 continues to break records at the box office, and the latest territory internationally is the UK, where it surpassed Leo. 
 The post  Jailer 2 UK Box Office: Makes History As Kollywood’s Highest-Grossing Film Of All Time!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Rajinikanth’s Jailer 2 is a box office juggernaut, and its journey of breaking records isn’t going to stop anytime soon. Backed by favorable word-of-mouth among the masses, the magnum opus is fetching solid numbers not just in India but internationally as well. After amassing strong numbers in North America and the Middle East, the UK is another territory where the film is minting moolah. Keep reading for a detailed report!
While Thalaiva’s last mega-budget film, Coolie , fell short of expectations, he’s making sure to set new benchmarks in the UK with his new film. The film started its run on a strong note, scoring £394K on day 1. Further, with word-of-mouth coming into play, it consistently attracted footfall, reaching a grand total of £1.6 million at the UK box office in 10 days. In Indian rupees, it equals 15.19 crore .
By scoring £1.6 million in just 10 days, Jailer 2 has emerged as Kollywood’s highest-grossing film of all time at the UK box office. It surpassed Leo ( £1.58 million ) to claim the top spot. For Rajinikanth, it’s his third film in the top 5, after Jailer ( £1.337 million ) and Coolie ( £1.11 million ).
Take a look at Kollywood’s top 10 grossers in the UK:
Jailer 2 is directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and produced by Kalanithi Maran’s Sun Pictures. It also stars SJ Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Ramya Krishnan, and Vidya Balan in key roles. The film was reportedly made on a budget of 350 crore , making it Rajinikanth’s second-most expensive film, alongside Coolie ( 350 crore ), after 2.0 ( 575 crore ). It was released on October 15, 2026.
